_source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6(1)(a)-(g), Rule 6(2), Rule 7, Rule 9
_note: Font-size minimums in mm are drawn from Rule 7, Table I (by net quantity) and apply to the retail sale price and net quantity numerals specifically.

fields.label: Name & address of manufacturer/packer/importer
fields.guidance: If a company name/address appears with no qualifying word, it is presumed to be the manufacturer under Explanation 1 to Rule 6(1)(a).

fields.label: Common/generic name of the commodity
fields.guidance: Usually the product name itself (e.g. 'Refined Sunflower Oil'). Checked heuristically — presence of any recognizable product-type word.

fields.label: Net quantity (standard unit of weight/measure/number)
fields.guidance: Must be in SI units (Rule 13) — gram/kilogram/millilitre/litre, not ounces/pounds.

fields.label: Month & year of manufacture/packing/import
fields.guidance: Exempt for bidis, incense sticks, and PSU-marketed domestic LPG cylinders (Rule 6(1) proviso).

fields.label: Maximum Retail Price (MRP), inclusive of all taxes
fields.guidance: Rule 2(m) requires the exact form 'MRP Rs.___ incl. of all taxes' or similar — price alone without the tax-inclusive qualifier is non-standard.

fields.label: Consumer care name, address, phone/email
fields.guidance: A distinct requirement from Rule 6(1) — must give a name, address, phone or email for complaints.

fields.label: Country of origin (imported goods)
fields.rule: Rule 6(1)(a) proviso / Legal Metrology Order on COO
fields.guidance: Only mandatory for imported packages; not applicable to domestically manufactured goods.

font_size_table_mm._source: Rule 7, Table I — minimum numeral height for RSP and net quantity declarations

manner_rules.language: Rule 9(4): declarations must be in Hindi (Devanagari) or English.
manner_rules.contrast: Rule 9(1)(b): RSP and net quantity numerals must be printed in a colour contrasting with the background.
manner_rules.legibility: Rule 9(1)(a): every declaration must be legible and prominent.
